exerciseId.description: The exercise this is: an id in the exercise list - a built-in's English catalog name, or a user exercise's uuid. Everything the app writes has one. Leave it out when authoring a plan by hand: the app links the exercise by `name` on import, to one of the user's own exercises or a built-in, and only makes a new exercise when nothing matches. An id the importing device doesn't know is treated the same way.
